versions.content: If frames with a payload <= 8 (either CAN 2.0 frames or small CAN FD frames) are used for a Rx N - SDU and CanTpRxPaddingActivation is equal to CANTP_ON , then CanTp shall only accept SF Rx N - PDUs or last C F Rx N - PDUs, belonging to that N - SDU, with a length of eight bytes (i.e. PduInfoPtr.SduLength = 8).
